C9_00_archive_door.speaker: narrator
C9_00_archive_door.text: The railway tear has closed into a door. The Ticket to Nowhere is warm in Reno's pocket.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: The door opens onto shelves that go up forever.

C9_01_archive.speaker: narrator
C9_01_archive.text: The Archive Between Worlds. Every forgotten thing ends up here: names, songs, birthdays, the smell of a grandmother's kitchen. Shelf after shelf, all the way up.

C9_01_archive.speaker: index
C9_01_archive.text: Shh. Welcome. I am Index. I keep the catalogue. You are... ah. Reno and Lumi. You have a very thick file.

C9_01_archive.speaker: index
C9_01_archive.text: Everyone does. His is the thickest. He has been here every night for twelve years, filing things away.

C9_01_archive.speaker: index
C9_01_archive.text: The stacks are behind three catalogue gates. Each wants something you carried here.

index_hint.speaker: index
index_hint.text: Gate one is O, for Oathkeepers. Gate two asks a question. Gate three is 1951. Shh.

gate_locked.speaker: narrator
gate_locked.text: A catalogue gate with a brass slot. It wants something.

gate_locked.speaker: index
gate_locked.text: Not that. Something you carried from the journey.

C9_01_gate_1.speaker: narrator
C9_01_gate_1.text: Galen slides the Oath Stone Rubbing into the slot. The gate reads it, sighs, and swings open.

C9_01_gate_2.speaker: index
C9_01_gate_2.text: Gate two asks: whose Promise is it?

then.speaker: index
then.text: No. They only kept it. Try again.

then.speaker: index
then.text: Yes. That's what the flowers remembered, isn't it?

then.speaker: index
then.text: That's what HE would say. Try again.

C9_01_gate_3.speaker: narrator
C9_01_gate_3.text: Reno feeds the Ticket to Nowhere into the last slot. The gate stamps it 1951, and opens.

C9_01_gate_3.speaker: index
C9_01_gate_3.text: The reading room of 1951 is ahead. Only Lumi can read those pages, I think. They're written in light.

ar01_pages_beaten.speaker: narrator
ar01_pages_beaten.text: The blank pages flutter back onto their shelf.

ar02_wraith_beaten.speaker: maris
ar02_wraith_beaten.text: Hold still, everyone. That ink stings.

C9_02_reading.speaker: narrator
C9_02_reading.text: The reading room of 1951. Three pages glow on three desks. The air smells like rain on a railway platform.

C9_02_reading.speaker: lumi
C9_02_reading.text: These pages are... me. I can feel them.

page_reno.speaker: narrator
page_reno.text: A glowing page. The writing is made of light and slides away when Reno looks at it.

C9_02_page_1.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_1.text: Page one. 1951, the night of a Lantern Moon. The Oathkeepers gather to open a crossing, the way they did every twelve years, so the worlds can visit.

C9_02_page_1.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_1.text: The youngest Oathkeeper is leading it for the first time. His hands are shaking.

C9_02_page_1.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_1.text: A fourth page slides out from under the desks, as if someone hid it there.

C9_02_page_2.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_2.text: Page two. The crossing opens under the railway station, just as a train arrives. Too many people. The gap starts to tear.

C9_02_page_2.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_2.text: The young Oathkeeper freezes. A railway worker named Maya and a guardian named Seri run into the gap and hold it open with their hands, while everyone else gets across.

C9_02_page_2.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_2.text: A fourth page slides out from under the desks, as if someone hid it there.

C9_02_page_3.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_3.text: Page three. The last one across is a very small spirit child, crying. Maya presses her railway token into his hand. Seri's light wraps around him, then breaks into a thousand tiny echoes, and one of them follows him.

C9_02_page_3.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_3.text: The gap closes. Maya and Seri are on the other side of it.

C9_02_page_3.speaker: reno
C9_02_page_3.text: ...That's me. The baby with the token. That's ME.

C9_02_page_3.speaker: lumi
C9_02_page_3.text: And the echo that followed you. That's me, Reno. I'm a piece of Seri.

C9_02_page_3.speaker: narrator
C9_02_page_3.text: A fourth page slides out from under the desks, as if someone hid it there.

desk_not_yet.speaker: narrator
desk_not_yet.text: A door marked PRIVATE. It won't open.

desk_not_yet.speaker: lumi
desk_not_yet.text: Not until we've read the pages.

C9_03_mayas_page.speaker: narrator
C9_03_mayas_page.text: A small page, folded many times, in the Keeper's careful handwriting. At the top: "Things to forget."

C9_03_mayas_page.speaker: narrator
C9_03_mayas_page.text: It's Maya's last words, written down by the young Oathkeeper as she said them through the gap:

C9_03_mayas_page.speaker: maya
C9_03_mayas_page.text: "Tell them to keep the doors open. Don't let this make anyone afraid."

C9_03_mayas_page.speaker: elias
C9_03_mayas_page.text: He heard her. And he filed it away, so he'd never have to hear it again.

C9_03_mayas_page.speaker: narrator
C9_03_mayas_page.text: Got Maya's Page. The door at the top of the reading room opens.

C9_04_desk.speaker: narrator
C9_04_desk.text: The Keeper's desk. Ledgers piled high. Ink everywhere. He is writing, and doesn't look up.

C9_04_keeper_intro.speaker: keeper
C9_04_keeper_intro.text: You read them. Then you know. I froze. Two people paid for it.

C9_04_keeper_intro.speaker: reno
C9_04_keeper_intro.text: You didn't make the gap. You were scared. That's different.

C9_04_keeper_intro.speaker: keeper
C9_04_keeper_intro.text: If the worlds never touch, nobody is ever lost again. I'm so close. Don't make me erase you too.

C9_04_keeper_intro.speaker: lumi
C9_04_keeper_intro.text: We have something of yours. Something you hid.

C9_04_keeper_intro.speaker: keeper
C9_04_keeper_intro.text: ...Then I'll have to take it back.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: narrator
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: The Keeper stumbles against his desk. Ledgers slide to the floor.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: reno
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: (holding up the page) She said keep the doors open. She said don't be afraid. You WROTE it down!

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: narrator
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: For a long moment he just looks at the page. His ink-stained hand reaches for it, and stops.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: keeper
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: If I stop now, then everything I've done was for nothing. Twelve years of nothing.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: keeper
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: The First Crossing. Where the very first Promise was made. I'll unmake it there, and it will all be over.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: narrator
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: He folds into his grey coat like a closing book and is gone. Something small and bright rolls across the floor.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: narrator
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: Got the Oathkeeper's Pin (Reno: ATK +3, SPD +2).

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: index
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: The First Crossing is the oldest place there is. If the Promise is unmade there, every door closes. Forever.

C9_04_keeper_flees.speaker: galen
C9_04_keeper_flees.text: Then we go to the First Crossing. All of us. And we bring him home.

crossing_door_wait.speaker: narrator
crossing_door_wait.text: A door of warm gold light. Beyond it, the First Crossing.
